title: bgp: split labeled ipv6 vpn into different items
description:
This PR splits the single item in the NLRI field for Labeled IPv6 VPN AFI into multiple. This enables tshark users to use parse this information. 

Added fields: Prefix Length, Label Stack, Route Distinguisher, IPv6 Prefix

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10584/diffs?diff_id=680488691&start_sha=b089cc4262e122d6f883f7f5b1b1c96395b3e91d)

Hi,

Before the display was: 
```
Path Attribute - MP_REACH_NLRI
    Flags: 0x90, Optional, Extended-Length, Non-transitive, Complete
    Type Code: MP_REACH_NLRI (14)
    Length: 57
    Address family identifier (AFI): IPv6 (2)
    Subsequent address family identifier (SAFI): Labeled VPN Unicast (128)
    Next hop:  RD=0:0 IPv6=::ffff:198.51.100.61
        Route Distinguisher: 0:0
        IPv6 Address: ::ffff:198.51.100.61
    Number of Subnetwork points of attachment (SNPA): 0
    Network Layer Reachability Information (NLRI)     <--- from this
        Label Stack=48036 (bottom) RD=64499:11, IPv6=2001:db8::10/128 
```
With the only item in NLRI having the path `bgp.label_stack`

With these changes it becomes:
```
Path Attribute - MP_REACH_NLRI
    Flags: 0x90, Optional, Extended-Length, Non-transitive, Complete
    Type Code: MP_REACH_NLRI (14)
    Length: 57
    Address family identifier (AFI): IPv6 (2)
    Subsequent address family identifier (SAFI): Labeled VPN Unicast (128)
    Next hop:  RD=0:0 IPv6=::ffff:198.51.100.61
        Route Distinguisher: 0:0
        IPv6 Address: ::ffff:198.51.100.61
    Number of Subnetwork points of attachment (SNPA): 0
    Network Layer Reachability Information (NLRI)      <---- to this
        Prefix length: 216     
        Label Stack: 48036 (bottom)
        Route Distinguisher: 64499:11
        MP Reach NLRI IPv6 prefix: 2001:db8::10/128
```
Now the 4 different fields have the paths: `bgp.prefix_length`, `bgp.label_stack`, `bgp.rd`, `bgp.mp_reach_nlri_ipv6_prefix` (or `bgp.mp_unreach_nlri_ipv6_prefix`)

The only thing is I am not sure if I should display the byte value of the field or the actual length of the prefix in the "Prefix Length" field. For now I am displaying the value from the bytes.
